title: Retromorphic Testing with Hierarchical Verification for Hallucination Detection in RAG
authors: Boxi Yu; Yuzhong Zhang; Liting Lin; Lionel Briand; Emir Muñoz
why_relevant: Proposes a hallucination/faithfulness detector for RAG that flags unsupported or contradicted claims against retrieved context, and introduces an enhanced RAGTruth benchmark. Relevant to evaluation of context-faithfulness and detection of conflicts between generation and retrieved evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on post-hoc detection rather than mitigating noisy/adversarial retrieval directly.
